lede: The biggest item this week is the San Miguel County BOCC's special meeting Wednesday, where they'll consider changing the AMI limits on deed-restricted properties at Pinion Park — a technical-sounding move that directly shapes who qualifies for local workforce housing. Also worth watching: the County Planning Commission takes up three Land Use Code amendments covering forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal energy on Thursday, and the Ridgway Town Council meets Wednesday to ratify letters supporting a federal Major Disaster Declaration tied to the Gold Mountain Fire, which has scorched nearly 40,000 acres and repeatedly cut off Highway 550.

notable.stake: Council ratifies disaster declaration support for 40,000-acre Gold Mountain Fire.
